checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Entire image neutral black and white, no red or colour remaining
must.why: The red is gone, but the car looks like a pale grey-green and is not clearly neutral grey. The tint is faint, so I'm not certain.

must.item: Same hatchback, same position, unchanged body details
must.why: The car shape, position, wheels, mirror and lights are all the same. The car body is much lighter than a plain desaturation of red would give.

must.item: Street and background objects keep position and appearance apart from colour
must.why: The houses, trees, pole, shadow and background cars are in the same places. Some small details are slightly altered.

must.item: Full composition retained, no cropping, same shape
must.why: The framing and aspect ratio match the original.

faults.what: The car body is rendered much lighter than a true desaturation of red would be, and it appears to have a faint green-grey tint. The tonal result looks like an AI re-grade, not a plain colour removal.
The AI editor changed the contrast and contents slightly. The sky is blown out and the plate and tail-light tones differ. The distant red car blends into the scene.

summary: The image came out as a faithful black-and-white version with the same framing and layout, but the car is lighter than a pure desaturation and may carry a faint tint.
